pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and non-convex geometries. Patches on the central flank display significantly larger spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed regions on the visible upper limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-toned negative space. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing at points of high patch proximity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder, displaying a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour against the background.
